[00:43.14] Tere bina lagta nahin dil mera (nahin dil mera)
[00:52.36] Mm-mm-mm, reh jaayegi kahani meri
[00:58.65] Adhoori jo tu na mila
[01:03.08] "Meri banogi kya? Meri rahogi kya?"
[01:08.43] Poochhe dil mera tumse yahi
[01:13.52] Meri banogi kya? Meri rahogi kya?
[01:18.85] Ab toh aadat lagi hai teri
[01:25.44]
